name: Innovex 16" Remote Stand Fan ISF165R
description: 16-inch Innovex remote-controlled stand fan with 7.5-hour timer, 3 speeds and full oscillation. Copper ball bearing motor with 1-year warranty.
details: The Innovex ISF165R is a 16-inch remote stand fan designed for convenient cooling. It features a remote control, 7.5-hour timer, 3 speed settings, full 90° oscillation, tilting angle and height adjustment. Equipped with a copper wire double ball bearing motor and poly-coated safety grill. Offers natural, normal and sleeping wind modes. Ideal for homes and offices in Sri Lanka. Backed by a 1-year warranty.
